decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 08.00 to 18.00 on Mondays to Friday and 09.00 to 13.00 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Informative - All trees on this property are protected by a Tree Protection Order. An application to perform surgery or removal of trees must be submitted to and approved by the Council prior to the work being undertaken.
description: Erection of 2 storey rear extension to dwellinghouse
